scripts.start: wp-env start && pnpm mailpit:start && pnpm dev
scripts.backup:db: pnpm wp-env run cli wp db export ./sql/backup-$(date +%Y%m%d).sql
scripts.backup:db:win: powershell -Command "pnpm wp-env run cli wp db export ./sql/backup-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd').sql"
scripts.import:db: pnpm wp-env run cli wp db import
scripts.patterns:flush: pnpm wp-env run cli wp eval 'wp_get_theme()->delete_pattern_cache();'
scripts.setup: node setup.js && pnpm mailpit:start && pnpm dev
scripts.php:lint: git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.php$' | xargs -I {} sh -c 'php -l {} || exit 1'
scripts.php:cs: sh -c '[ ! -x vendor/bin/phpcs ] && echo "phpcs not found — run: pnpm composer install" && exit 1; vendor/bin/phpcs'
scripts.php:cs:staged: sh -c '[ ! -x vendor/bin/phpcs ] && echo "phpcs not found, skipping (run: pnpm composer install)" && exit 0; files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep "\.php$" || true); [ -z "$files" ] && exit 0; echo "$files" | xargs vendor/bin/phpcs'
scripts.php:stan: sh -c '[ ! -x vendor/bin/phpstan ] && echo "phpstan not found — run: pnpm composer install" && exit 1; vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G'
scripts.lint: pnpm format:check && pnpm stylelint:check && pnpm eslint:check && pnpm php:lint:all && pnpm php:cs && pnpm php:stan
